question: India's first seaplane service, that was launched in November 2020, operates between Kevadiya and ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ahmedabad.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's first seaplane service,** which was launched in **November 2020**, operates** between Kevadiya and Ahmedabad.**
 
• The service will be operated by **Spicejet Airline from Sabarmati riverfront in Ahmedabad to Statue of Unity in Kevadia.**
 
• An MoU was signed between **Chief Minister Vijay Rupani and the Ministry of Civil Aviation (MOCA) and Airports Authority of India to start the "first-ever seaplane services in Gujarat.**
 
• The** water aerodrome scheme** is being implemented by the **terms and conditions of a tripartite agreement between the state government, the Ministry of Civil Aviation (MoCA), and the Airports Authority of India.**
 
• SpiceJet will operate a** 19-seater plane**, which will be able to accommodate**14 passengers**. The ticket price would be around** 4,800 per person.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **​Bhupendrabhai Patel is the current Chief Minister of Gujarat **
